title: Original data and R code for "Seasonal Environmental Variability and Asynchronous Changes in Dissolved Organic Matter in Lake Erhai"
description:
This dataset contains the original field and laboratory data, the derived datasets, and the R code supporting the manuscript Seasonal Environmental Variability and Asynchronous Changes in Dissolved Organic Matter in Lake Erhai (submitted to Water, MDPI).

Contents: raw and processed field environmental data (water temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity, nutrients), dissolved organic carbon (DOC) concentrations, DOM fluorescence components and fluorescence indices (Fn(355), FI, HIX, BIX), chlorophyll-a, Carlson trophic state index, compiled datasets and correlation matrices, together with the R scripts used for data processing, statistical analysis and figure generation.
notes: Code (.R) is released under the MIT License; data (.xlsx) under CC BY 4.0.
